items.html: And the externality of the worlds is bodies and vessels. For the vessels of Assiyah, etc., and from their coupling are made the vessels of the Nefashot, and they are the Ofanim, and are called the vessels of the Nefashot. And from the vessels of Yetzirah, which has in it the five above-mentioned aspects in the aspect of vessels — and they are the vessels of Malchut, the vessels of ZA, and the vessels of Bina, etc. — from their coupling are made the angels of Yetzirah, and all of them are called the vessels of the Ruchin, as it is written, 'He makes His angels spirits.'
